line: A clumsy cadet survives a five-second boot camp, faster and faster, until the boss: landing home.
line_cn: 见习宇航员闯五秒训练营，越来越快，Boss 关亲手降落回地球。

labels: The command word is the subtitle: a heavy display face (e.g. Titan One), white with a thick ink outline, a coloured drop and a burst behind it, skewed a few degrees. It slams in over ~3 frames (overshoot → settle), holds, then shrinks into a corner tag before the first action, so the result is never covered. One-off banners fly out instead of tagging, so tags never pile up.

Other lines: a rounded card in the home palette with the home outline and hard shadow, a friendly rounded face (e.g. Lilita One ~50 px), a small speaker icon; placed above the timer in games. Hold ≥ max(1.8 s, speech + 0.6 s), never under a big banner.
Inside a game, any text (replay captions, labels) uses that medium's own typography.
The command word appears in the .srt only, never burned twice.
motion: The frame rate is part of the ladder: characters step on twos or at 8 fps early, faster later, on ones at the climax. Camera moves, transitions and the timer spark always run on ones.
Five things accelerate together at each speed-up: tempo, game length, stage dwell, command hold, character frame rate.
The timer is visible and on the beat: e.g. a fuse with one knot per beat, the spark passing each knot exactly on it. It freezes in a replay.
Unified transition through the frame-within-the-frame: push into the screen to start a game (~0.25 s), shrink the game back into it to return (~0.33 s) with a ✓ / ✗ stamp. No fades, no blank frames.

native_moves.name: Style switch per game
native_moves.does: Each task is drawn in the medium that suits it.
native_moves.fits: the steps of baking bread (flour in crayon, oven dial in blueprint, crust in woodcut); a day of a nurse; a heist's roles.

native_moves.name: Command word
native_moves.does: One verb is script, subtitle and downbeat.
native_moves.fits: SCAN! at a checkout; BREATHE! in a yoga class; SIGN! at a contract signing.

native_moves.name: Lives as UI
native_moves.does: The counter carries emotion without narration; 3 → 2 → 1 (blinking) builds tension alone.
native_moves.fits: a phone battery; retries on a driving test; chances left on a quiz.

native_moves.name: SPEED UP
native_moves.fits: rush hour; the last week before a deadline; a kitchen during dinner service.

native_moves.name: Failure becomes the solution
native_moves.does: The material of an earlier failure returns in the final game as the answer.
native_moves.fits: a spilled coffee that later stains the winning map; a bug that becomes a feature; a missed train that leads to the right meeting.

native_moves.name: Boss mixes the rules
native_moves.does: The final game is built from pieces of earlier media.
native_moves.fits: a final exam; launch day; a festival's closing night.

native_moves.name: Instant replay
native_moves.does: The joke explained in slow motion.
native_moves.fits: a goal-line decision; a typo that shipped; a cat's leap that missed.

score.note: a constant groove plus one colour instrument per medium
